environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless function deployed on AWS Lambda via SAM. FeatureFlagService backed by Split.io SDK with targeting rules configured to return `true` for flag 'enable-deep-config-merge' for all contexts matching environment='production'. The Lambda is invoked via API Gateway HTTP API with no request validation template. Split workspace 'acme-prod' has the flag at 100% rollout for production environment since sprint 47 (2024-01-15).
